acceptance_scope: independent-role deterministic machine acceptance; no customer or human usability certification
cpu_scope: worker process from startup plus completed child processes, through packaging; final receipt serialization tail excluded
observed_primary_resources.scope_note: Primary local reused workflow only. Machine acceptance is not customer or independent human acceptance. Receipt CPU excludes final serialization tail, host idle time and development/construction. Operational zero model calls do not make construction free.

assumptions.v_status: ASSUMED_ZERO_FOR_LABOR_COST_REFERENCE; actual nonlabor cost is unknown, not measured zero
assumptions.allocation_scope: Assumed maintenance, amortized construction and all otherwise unpriced non-attention overhead per attempt. F/N_attempts is a possible investment allocation. Do not insert F/N_accepted here and divide by q again.
assumptions.time_scope: Assumed per-attempt effort includes its ordinary preparation, review and within-attempt correction. Separate rejected attempts are represented by q; do not count the same rework in t and q twice.
assumptions.cpu_statistic_for_scenarios: Observed primary median; observed min/max are a resource-range sensitivity, not confidence bounds. Aggregate campaign resource cost uses sum/accepted, not median.
assumptions.currency_policy: Each source currency is calculated independently. Equal numeric CAD, USD and EUR assumptions do not assert exchange equivalence; no additional FX conversion.
assumptions.acceptance_policy: Scenario q values are sensitivity assumptions, not confidence limits or matched observed human reliability. Observed 36/36 applies only to frozen machine checks.
assumptions.capacity_policy: Effort capacity ratio compares accepted outputs per employer-attention hour under assumptions. It is not measured throughput, headcount reduction, cash savings or profit.
